title: Civil Code, Division 3, Part 4, Title 1.7, Chapter 1 (Song-Beverly Consumer Warranty Act)
verified_how: The CIV Div 3 Part 4 tree shows 'TITLE 1.7. CONSUMER WARRANTIES', 'CHAPTER 1. Consumer Warranty Protection 1790-1795.8'. §1790 says it may be cited as the 'Song-Beverly Consumer Warranty Act'.
notes: Warranties, refunds and repair, including the lemon law.
